source_note: Original demonstration practice; not official MOE/SEAB questions.

questions.prompt: The witness gave a ___ account, including every small detail.
questions.explanation: “Detailed” means including many facts or particulars.

questions.prompt: If I ___ about the road closure, I would have taken another route.
questions.explanation: This is a third conditional: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

questions.prompt: Kai practised quietly each day instead of boasting about his skills. What can you infer?
options: He wants others to do all the work.
questions.explanation: Regular practice suggests that Kai focuses on improving his skills.
